clients: SELECT CLAVE,NOMBRE,CVE_VEND,STATUS,SALDO,CON_CREDITO,LIMCRED,DIASCRED FROM CLIE15 WHERE TRIM(CLAVE) IN ('845','865','1994','1650')
ledger: SELECT 'M' AS SOURCE,NUM_CPTO,SIGNO,COUNT(*) AS N,SUM(IMPORTE) AS AMOUNT,SUM(IMPORTE*SIGNO) AS SIGNED FROM CUEN_M15 WHERE TRIM(CVE_CLIE)='845' GROUP BY NUM_CPTO,SIGNO UNION ALL SELECT 'D',NUM_CPTO,SIGNO,COUNT(*),SUM(IMPORTE),SUM(IMPORTE*SIGNO) FROM CUEN_DET15 WHERE TRIM(CVE_CLIE)='845' GROUP BY NUM_CPTO,SIGNO
roots: SELECT FIRST 8 CVE_CLIE,REFER,NUM_CARGO,NO_FACTURA,IMPORTE,SIGNO,FECHA_VENC,STATUS,STRCVEVEND FROM CUEN_M15 WHERE TRIM(CVE_CLIE)='845' ORDER BY FECHA_APLI DESC
balance: SELECT M.REFER,M.NUM_CARGO,MAX(M.NO_FACTURA) AS INVOICE,SUM(M.IMPORTE*M.SIGNO)+(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(D.IMPORTE*D.SIGNO),0) FROM CUEN_DET15 D WHERE D.CVE_CLIE=M.CVE_CLIE AND D.REFER=M.REFER AND D.NUM_CARGO=M.NUM_CARGO) AS BALANCE FROM CUEN_M15 M WHERE TRIM(M.CVE_CLIE)='845' GROUP BY M.CVE_CLIE,M.REFER,M.NUM_CARGO HAVING ABS(SUM(M.IMPORTE*M.SIGNO)+(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(D.IMPORTE*D.SIGNO),0) FROM CUEN_DET15 D WHERE D.CVE_CLIE=M.CVE_CLIE AND D.REFER=M.REFER AND D.NUM_CARGO=M.NUM_CARGO))>0.005
statuses: SELECT STATUS,COUNT(*) AS N FROM CLIE15 GROUP BY STATUS
